issues.description: Return type of Farm.addAnimal is inconsistent: the UML in problem_statement.md specifies addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, but the solution implementation defines addAnimal(Animal) as void (and the template does not define the method yet). This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should implement addAnimal to return a boolean or void and may cause unexpected compile/test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either update the UML/problem statement to indicate addAnimal(Animal): void (preferred, since callers do not use a return value) or change the solution (and template) to implement addAnimal(Animal): boolean and return true/false depending on whether the animal was added. Also ensure the template's Farm.java includes the chosen signature so students implement the correct method.
